body.x: We are looking for MIK (MADE IN KOREA) companies to participate in the world's largest technology exhibition CES 2020. MIK project is expected to be an opportunity for Korean innovative startups who are looking to enter the global market.

CES is a highly popular event that attracts more than 170,000 people every year as a competition for innovative companies. More than 4,400 companies participated in CES 2019, among which 307 companies selected as Fortune Global Company 500 actively participated in the event. In addition to exhibitors, more than 175,000 people participated in CES 2019, including 61,000 industry officials and those outside the US, once again uplifting CES’s position.

Why is CES attracting so much attention from around the world? Along with the advantages of seeing industry trends at a glance, business networking is active. In particular, startup Eureka Park showcases innovative ideas from around the world, and there are many investments, acquisitions, and media issues happening. Since 2012, the cumulative investment has amounted to $ 1.5 billion (about 1.7 trillion won).

Last year, the MIK (MADE IN KOREA) INNOVATION HOT SPOT zone, which can intensively announce Korean startups, was run separately to inform the world of the power of Korean companies. Accordingly, the upcoming MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT event, which will be held at the CES 2020 site, is also expected to attract the attention of many participating companies.

Companies participating in CES 2020 MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT can actively introduce their own systems and products by both online and offline promotions. Exhibitors’ benefits are as follows. △ Production and distribution of promotional leaflets for MIK Innovation Hot Spot △ Pitching opportunities △ Articles through global media △ Production and distribution of company videos △ Networking party to meet media, investors, and buyers △ Eligibility to receive award (BEST of MIK @ CES 2020)

As global companies and investors are enthusiastically searching for new technologies and places to invest by visiting CES startup zone Eureka Park, it is time for Korean companies to actively participate in the event.

MADE IN KOREA (MIK), which was launched by AVING NEWS in 2016 with the mission to promoting Korean companies to the world, is the global project designed to help the Korean companies expand their businesses by using the globally collaborating media, YouTubers, crowdfunding platforms, and investors to promote them to domestic and international markets.

More than 700 companies have participated in the MIK project over the past four years, and their stories have been reported as thousands of news through domestic and international media. In CES 2019 held last year, the first overseas MIK took place to lead in promoting Korean SMEs.
